fine: Correct AtliQ entity: Pvt Ltd for a Germany counterparty
Parties = invoicing entity: Pvt Ltd throughout
Liability capped: total remuneration under this Agreement
Payment within 30 days of receipt matches the standard.
Aggregate liability capped at total remuneration (fees) for slight negligence; mandatory law carve-outs for German law (intent, gross negligence) are acceptable.
Indemnity is mutual for breach and negligence, and includes standard IP infringement coverage subject to general liability limits.
AtliQ retains ownership of its background IP (PipeKit) and grants a license, while client owns specific work results upon payment.
Termination for convenience ensures AtliQ is paid for services rendered and committed costs.
Includes a 10-day review period and deemed acceptance if the client fails to respond.
Standard data protection language referencing DPA and SCCs for transfer to India.
Requirement for written consent to subcontract is a standard operational control rather than a non-compete.
